module TopModule(input  clk, input  areset, input  bump_left, input  bump_right, input  ground, input  dig, output reg walk_left, output reg walk_right, output reg aaah, output reg digging);
    reg [2:0] state, next_state;
    reg [23:0] fall_timer;
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            3'b000: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; digging = 0; next_state = bump_left ? 3'b001 : (bump_right ? 3'b010 : (ground ? 3'b000 : 3'b100)); end
            3'b001: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 1; aaah = 0; digging = 0; next_state = bump_left ? 3'b001 : (bump_right ? 3'b010 : (ground ? 3'b000 : 3'b100)); end
            3'b010: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; digging = 0; next_state = bump_left ? 3'b001 : (bump_right ? 3'b010 : (ground ? 3'b000 : 3'b100)); end
            3'b100: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 0; aaah = ground ? 1 : 0; digging = 0; fall_timer = fall_timer + 1; next_state = bump_left ? 3'b001 : (bump_right ? 3'b010 : (dig ? 3'b011 : (fall_timer < 24 ? 3'b100 : (ground ? 3'b000 : 3'b101)))); end
            3'b011: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; digging = 1; next_state = ground ? 3'b000 : 3'b011; end
            3'b101: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 1; digging = 0; next_state = 3'b000; end
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 3'b000;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (state == 3'b101) fall_timer <= 0;
    end
endmodule
